limitations: Headless packet tests do not render or automate the Bedrock inventory UI.
Retail inventory drag behavior and attachable rendering require a retail client test.

version7Feedback: Ender pearl and axe appear at the lower left with an improved ordinary-item pose.
Apple idle model is lower than the ender pearl and partly below the screen.
Stone remains small and far away in the upper-left view.
renderVerification.blockChange: Retain original native item identifiers and Geyser block runtime definitions instead of custom fallback items. Convert their native item version to DATA_DRIVEN and enable offhand, native block icon and default Java stack sizes. Preserve original mappings/damage/NBT for colored variants.
renderVerification.foodChange: Only first-person left-food idle X/Y move from (-13.5,0.2) to (-17.0,2.2). Geometry, main-hand and third-person food poses, and eating/drinking animation formulas remain unchanged.
renderVerification.preserved: Torch variants retain prior fallback/pose; ender pearl and tools retain version 7 mirrored vanilla arm pose; shield retains native identifier.
